## Scope and limitations

- Supports HTTP and HTTPS forward proxies using Undici `ProxyAgent`.
- Does not support SOCKS or PAC

proxy URLs.
- Covers provider implementations that use `globalThis.fetch`, including the
native DSH

DeepSeek adapter and the common fetch-based pi-ai providers.
- Also wraps DSH's `llm.discoverModels

()` path, so Models → “Fetch available
models” uses the selected Provider's proxy when that request

names a
provider route.
- If that Provider already has a non-empty static `models` list, DSH returns

the catalog without network I/O by design; clear that list when you want to
probe the provider endp

oint and observe the proxy connection.
- It does not rewrite `baseURL`. API relays/reverse proxies s

hould be configured
directly on the provider instead.
- Provider SDKs that bypass Fetch and open soc

kets directly need a dedicated
transport integration; this middleware deliberately does not enable a
process-wide proxy fallback.
